source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> Click tab "Settings" -> Click "User Management" to view user accounts.
2. Check the user list.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC WebUI Settings > User Management view shows the complete current account list and that displayed identities, slots, roles and supported states match the approved/default baseline and authoritative read-only account inventory.
original_method: Identify the BMC and approved account/slot baseline; collect complete protected paginated AccountService data; have an operator open every User Management page with filters visible; capture all displayed accounts; normalize UI/API ID, username, role, enabled/locked/local-directory state; report missing, extra, stale or mismatched entries without account changes.
manual_activity: A human opens the source WebUI path and captures every visible page/filter because API evidence cannot prove the WebUI presentation. Automation may collect and normalize the complete protected API inventory and comparison. No account mutation or point-of-action write approval is permitted; the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Approved configured/default account, slot, role and state baseline
WebUI/AccountService field mapping and pagination/filter semantics
Protected read account and TLS trust
safety_requirements: Do not use `curl -k`, expose credentials/tokens or include passwords/hash/secret fields in evidence; verify the intended BMC and trusted TLS path.
Do not clear security logs or add, modify, disable, delete, unlock or reset accounts, and do not terminate the protected recovery session to refresh the page.
Collect all AccountService members and expanded state fields; do not truncate to the first page or three fields.
Capture the actual WebUI User Management view with page count, filters and local/directory scope; API output alone does not satisfy source WebUI coverage.
Stop on wrong target, incomplete pagination/UI, role-ID ambiguity, hidden filters or unsafe redaction; preserve the discrepancy without attempting a write.
No automatic retry is required; if UI/API snapshots differ, record timestamps and freshness evidence instead of changing state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, baseline, schema/mapping, trusted read path and redaction; collect complete paginated expanded AccountService records.
Guide the operator through Settings > User Management and capture all pages, filters and supported displayed fields without changing accounts.
Normalize UI/API/baseline identities, roles and states and report every missing, extra, stale or mismatched entry with timestamps.
Confirm no write/audit event, archive redacted evidence and return facts without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Provide the approved/default account baseline, protected-account list, role/state mapping and redaction rules.
Perform or witness complete WebUI view capture and resolve legitimate local/directory representation differences.
Review comparison evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The endpoint is relevant read-only corroboration but `-k` defeats trust, inline basic auth risks secrets, collection may omit pagination/member detail and the jq projection loses states. It cannot replace the required WebUI view.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected vendor-supported AccountService enumeration with verified TLS, pagination and member expansion, plus the exact human WebUI path; never invoke account actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Settings > User Management view, user-list check, configured/default Criteria, no Script, DeepSeek command/risk and 5/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture every WebUI account page/filter and compare it to a complete trusted paginated API inventory and approved baseline using normalized identity/role/state fields.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC WebUI User Management page and read-only account service.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build, Redfish/schema and client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor User Management/AccountService schema and Project account/role policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds completeness, secure transport, field normalization, redaction and explicit discrepancy reporting while retaining the WebUI checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API inventory does not prove WebUI rendering; WebUI screenshots alone may hide pagination/filters; neither proves Add/Delete/Modify functions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Account baseline, schema mapping, protected read path, WebUI access and redaction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Account metadata is sensitive; directory accounts may not map one-to-one to local slots; stale UI/API snapshots need timestamp correlation.

project_override_considerations: A Project may approve browser automation or a vendor UI-test framework only when the original WebUI path, actual method, reason, engineer approval, visual/navigation equivalence and uncovered manual coverage are recorded. Redfish alone is not an equivalent override.
expected_evidence: BMC/firmware/WebUI endpoint, approved/default account/slot/role/state baseline and protected recovery-account identification
Complete trusted paginated expanded redacted AccountService inventory with timestamps
All WebUI User Management pages/screenshots or DOM with filters, page count and visible field context
Normalized UI/API/baseline matrix covering identity, slot, role, enabled/locked/local-directory state and every discrepancy
No account/session/log mutation, preserved audit evidence and engineer-owned verdict

review_improvement: Prevents an insecure, first-page, three-field API response from being mistaken for complete WebUI account visibility while protecting sensitive account metadata.
independent_technical_reasoning: The case is specifically about WebUI visibility, so an API list can corroborate truth but cannot prove rendering, paging or filters. Conversely, one screenshot can omit hidden pages and states. A time-aligned normalized comparison of complete API members and every UI page is required, with a strict no-write boundary because viewing must not perturb the inventory.
